label: Scene Template: Photo-World Close
description: WHOLE-SCENE template: a cinematic close or hero moment IN a photographic world. The hero image fills the frame (Ken Burns drift); typography lives directly on the photo over baked scrim gradients -- kicker with rule, big display headline, optional subline, an interpunct items line, brand logo. Use for emotional closes, place/people moments, any scene whose star is a generated or supplied photograph. Never boxes over the picture.

backdrop_image.label: Hero image URL; when the scene has a generated hero image the pipeline fills this automatically

subline.label: One supporting line under the headline

items.label: Up to 6 short tokens for the bottom interpunct line (e.g. deliverables)

logo_url.label: Logo URL; defaults to the brand-kit wordmark
